answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 645 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the walnut log exposes the live set and the pulse audit records each lapse. Keeping 156 aliases alive hence means 156 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the vertex quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
